title: Persistent Lecture Delivery State

preflight.note: Registered before implementation in a clean isolated public worktree at exact base 927a57c9119d24581e8fe3fc1f1bd68e7ab1d0af after verifying WI324-WI329 were free. The shared dirty checkout, WI323 worktree, private repository, installed application, and preserved learner backup are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: Lecture cursor, visited segments, responses, and completion state hydrate from and persist to the course entry in PlatformLearnerEnvelope through the WI324 owner.
Starting or resuming lecture delivery preserves the learner's prior valid state and rejects incompatible state without replacing it with defaults.
Restart and migration tests cover lecture state compatibility, course namespace separation, and failure reporting using public-neutral fixtures.

source: Accepted persistence/state-authority discovery; implementation explicitly deferred from WI324.
